title: Add Method Name
instructions: To add an element to the end of a mutable list, call the _____ method.
prompt: To add an element to the end of a mutable list, call the _____ method.
explanation: The `.add()` method appends an element to the end of a mutable list. For example, `teams.add(4215)` puts 4215 at the end of the `teams` list.
